views.title: WeatherStar 4000+

summary:
WeatherStar 4000+ (vbguyny/ws4kp): a single-page retro weather-channel player. The page has a location search bar, a TV-style canvas iframe that cycles through forecast segments with playback controls, GitHub buttons, and settings for units, themes, scroll text and auto-refresh.

Saved 1 view:
- weather-player (goto /, then click Next): the main screen with the TV on the Current Conditions segment and all the settings below it.

What didn't work:
- The canvas inside the iframe renders zoomed and cropped in this browser. Only the top-left part of each segment shows (the logo and the title), so every segment (Latest Observations, Radar, etc.) looks almost the same. More segment views would just be near-duplicates.
- The large controls overlay toggles on and off unpredictably on load, so I couldn't save it as a stable view.
- Typing in the location search box put the page into a broken all-black state with the text gone. It never showed geocoder suggestions, so I couldn't capture a search or suggestions view.
- Opening /twc3.html directly only shows the "Loading" segment list, because it needs parameters from the parent page.
